description: Polls a job's status every few seconds for up to timeout_s (default 45, max 55 - most MCP clients cut a tool call at 60 s) and returns as soon as it is terminal. If it returns state='running', call it again - craftstory-2 jobs take 8-15 minutes, minimax-h3 1-3 minutes, audio clips seconds. Reports progress notifications when the client supports them.

timeout_s.description: How long this call may wait (default 45, max 55)

name: wait_for_job
title: Wait for a job (bounded polling)
